blind.description: An antique-style wooden washstand cabinet featuring four turned legs, a front drawer with a brass pull knob, and a cupboard door with brass hinges. It is topped with a white marble slab with a raised backsplash and side guard. Resting on the marble surface is a shallow ceramic wash basin with gold trim, an ornate ceramic water pitcher with a handle and gold rim, and a small brass towel rack mounted to the backsplash holding a folded towel.
blind.from_above: A rectangular marble slab bordered on the back and sides, containing a round ceramic wash bowl, an oval ceramic pitcher with a handle extending to the right, and a folded towel on a brass rod.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.8 to 3.0 feet tall including the backsplash) and roughly 2.5 feet wide.
